column3: NASB supplies “the territories”; “the heads of the households” renders “the heads of the fathers,” and “apportioned … for an inheritance” renders “gave as a possession.”
“through Moses” renders “by the hand of Moses.”
“they did not give” renders the impersonal “people did not give”; “property” renders “possessions.”
“concerning you and me” reverses the Hebrew order “concerning me and concerning you.”
“forty years old” renders “a son of forty years”; “as it was in my heart” renders “as with my heart.”
“brethren” renders “brothers”; NASB adds “with fear,” and “followed the LORD … fully” renders “filled after the LORD.”
“perhaps the LORD will be with me” supplies “will be.”
“followed the LORD … fully” renders “filled after the LORD.”
NASB supplies “for Arba was”; “had rest” renders “was at peace.”
